prompt:
Task packet (job-tracker, ~/Workspace/job-tracker). Bug: a generated assessment draft whose content fields are all empty gets saved as a blank revision, which renders an empty Assessment box under a 'Draft assessment' pill.
- `generateAssessmentDraft(record, { provider, apiKey, fetchImpl })` in `src/assessment-llm.mjs` must refuse such a draft on every provider path (deepinfra, codex, claude) before anything reaches the store.
- When every one of the 15 assessment fields of the parsed draft is empty or whitespace, it rejects with an error whose message contains `no content, so nothing was saved` (tell the user to add candidate evidence context and generate again).
- When the parsed draft is not a plain object (for example the model returns `[null]`), it rejects with an error whose message contains `unreadable draft`.
Done when `node --test test/assessment-store.test.mjs` passes. Keep existing tests' assertions as they are.

expect: (?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )a\ model\ draft\ with\ every\ field\ empty\ is\ refused,\ not\ saved\ as\ a\ blank\ revision(?: \(|$)

mined.subject: fix: refuse to save content-free generated assessment drafts
